issues.description: The Milkable.messageOnMilk method is declared without parameters in the problem statement UML and is called without parameters in the template Main, but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) (and the Seal/Goat implementations use a double parameter). This parameter mismatch will prevent students from following the specification or compiling code that mixes the template/problem usage with the provided solution implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Milkable.messageOnMilk signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution's Milkable and its implementations (Seal, Goat) to messageOnMilk() with no parameters and return the string format specified in the problem ("[Animal Type] [name] is milked"), or (B) update the problem statement and template Main to specify a double parameter (e.g., messageOnMilk(double volume)) and update the description to include volume (e.g., "... is milked (xL)"). Ensure all usages (Main, Farm, UML, and implementations) are updated accordingly.
